about: The HTML engine Soma desktop runs HTML artifacts in (docs/CHAT-ARTIFACT-WORKSPACE.md, 'Desktop HTML engine'): jcefmaven's Chromium natives, pinned. soma-release publishes these files beside the build when they change; the update pill installs them once. version must equal the jcefmaven version in gradle/libs.versions.toml and WebEngine.VERSION (test-soma-release.py checks). sha256 and size were taken from Maven Central's files and checked against its published sha1 (2026-10-29).
